text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia and Egypt aim to rise trade exchanges between the two countries to $300 million by the year 2000.
- Egyptian Prime Minister Kamel Ganzouri on Sunday stressed the good relations between Tunisia and Algeria at the end of his three-day official visit to Tunis.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali congratulates King Hassan II of Morocco on the occasion of 36th anniversary of his accession to throne.
- Tunisia and Egypt on Sunday signed cooperation accords in different sectors.
- Mauritanian President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya on Sunday held talks with Tunisian Parliament speaker Habib Boulares on ways to boost cooperation.
